How publishing works
Drafts are visible only to admins. Published products appear in the customer catalogue on its next load. Stock of zero prevents adding to cart. Leaving the regular price blank lets customers request a quote. Tags help search; separate them with commas. Product edits do not reserve stock or record a sale: agree payment and delivery on WhatsApp, then update stock here.

Add product

JPG, PNG or WebP, up to 5 MB each. First photo is the cover. Photos are resized to 1200px. Save the product after uploading.
